description: A fully client-side web app that provides Cricut cutting settings for any material, including ML-powered prediction for unknown materials using an MLP neural network exported to ONNX and run in the browser.

methodology.name: Deep Research
methodology.description: Research Cricut brand style, machine specs, and material properties relevant to cutting parameters.
notes: 3 research files saved (initial machines: Maker 3, Explore 3, Cricut Joy)
CSS extracted directly from cricut.com global.css — full color palette with hex codes confirmed
CSV data analyzed for machine specs and material properties
Key finding: machine must be an ML input feature (same material = different pressure per machine)
Key finding: Rotary blade fabric pressures (600-3550) are on a separate scale — may need special handling in ML
Key finding: Cricut Green = #1eb487 but fails WCAG AA; use accessible #1a8163 for CTA text contrast
3 new machine research files added: Joy 2 (2026), Joy Xtra (2023), Explore 5 (2026)
Joy 2: 84 materials, Fine-Point only, 90-350 pressure range. User provided Design Space data.
Joy Xtra: 112 materials, Fine-Point + Deep-Point, 50-400 pressure range. User provided Design Space data.
Explore 5: no new data — user confirmed to use Explore 3 CSV as proxy for now
3 custom user-created entries found in Joy Xtra data: 'Sticker new', 'Sticker sub one', 'stNew' — included as-is
Combined CSV now contains 729 rows across 5 machines: Maker 3 (313), Explore 3 (140), Joy Xtra (112), Joy 2 (84), Joy (80)

methodology.name: ML Model Training & ONNX Export
methodology.description: Train MLP (PyTorch, CUDA) on combined material CSV, evaluate, and export to ONNX. Save preprocessing artifacts.
notes: MLP: 19 inputs → 256→128→64→32 shared → 3 output heads (pressure, blade, multicut)
Training: 578 rows, 500 epochs, AdamW + CosineAnnealing, CUDA (RTX 4060)
Blade accuracy: 84.8%, F1: 87.5% — correctly identifies all 5 blade types
Pressure MAE: Joy-family 26-46, Explore 55 (good). Maker 3 total 227 (driven by rotary fabric 600-3550)
Key design: 'is_bonded_fabric' input distinguishes rotary (unbonded) vs bonded fabric pressure scales
Multi-cut accuracy: 59.3%, F1: 65.7% — inherently noisy task given limited features
ONNX: 200.8 KB, opset 12, verified with onnxruntime-web compatible shapes
preprocessor.json: 19-feature encoding spec, blade index→EN mapping, pressure decode formula

methodology.name: Test Specification
methodology.description: Define test cases for the web app (unit, integration, UI). Document in a Markdown test plan.
notes: 62 test cases across 9 sections: Data loading, ONNX loading, Feature encoding, Search/filter UI, ML prediction UI, Localization, Responsive layout, Accessibility, Edge cases
Critical acceptance criteria defined (no-tolerance: D-01-08, M-01-05, P-06-09, S-02/04/13, L-01-02, X-01-03)
6 regression test vectors defined for model stability checking
Test implementation plan: qunit unit tests, browser model_test.html, manual checklist, Node data integrity check
Style reference for Step 4: tamayuzucraft site (cream/teal palette, card-based, Noto Sans JP, chip filters)

methodology.name: UI / Landing Page Design
methodology.description: Design the app following Cricut international style. Requires Step 1 research to be complete.
notes: Style: Cricut Green #1eb487 primary, Alabaster #fafafa background, system+Noto Sans JP fonts
Layout inspired by tamayuzucraft (machine tabs → search → chips → cards) but fully Cricut-branded
Two mode tabs: Browse Materials | Predict (ML)
Category badge colors mapped to Cricut brand palette per category
Prediction form: machine select, category select, thickness (mm), hardness slider → result card with disclaimer
Mobile-first; breakpoints at 600px, 1024px; max-width 900px centered on desktop
i18n: 30+ string keys, EN/JP toggle via localStorage, Noto Sans JP lazy-loaded only in JP mode
File structure defined: index.html, styles.css, app.js, predict.js, i18n.js, materials.json build script

methodology.name: App Development
methodology.description: Build the static web app (HTML, CSS, JS) following the design spec. Integrate ONNX model.
notes: Browse mode: machine tabs (5 machines), category + blade chip filters, search (debounced 150ms), sort by pressure asc/desc, 1039-row card list
AI Predict mode: machine + category selects, thickness (mm) input, hardness slider (1-10), ONNX inference via onnxruntime-web 1.18 WASM
Feature encoding in predict.js mirrors Python build_X() exactly: 11-dim category one-hot, thickness log1p MinMax, hardness (h-1)/9, is_bonded=0, GSM/density/shore category defaults
Machine blade compatibility enforced in predict.js (e.g. Joy only predicts Fine-Point)
i18n: EN + JP string tables, auto-detect navigator.language, localStorage override, Noto Sans JP lazy-loaded only in JP mode
Cricut Green #1eb487 primary, Alabaster surface, per-category badge colors from brand palette
Responsive: single column mobile, 2-col grid @600px, 3-col + max-width 860px @1024px
prefers-reduced-motion: all transitions disabled
materials.json: 1039 rows, 239 KB, generated by scripts/build_materials_json.py

methodology.name: Testing & Fixes
methodology.description: Run all tests from the test plan, fix issues until all tests pass.
notes: 57 automated tests: 12 Node data integrity (D-01..D-08, M-01..M-03a), 24 browser unit (E, D, M, P validation), 21 ONNX model integration (M-01..M-09, P, Regression) — all pass
Fixed: QUnit 2.x has no assert.closeTo — replaced with assert.ok(Math.abs(...))
Fixed: test HTML pages inside tests/ need <base href="../"> so predict.js relative fetches resolve correctly
Regression vectors updated to v6 model predictions ±40% — Joy/Iron-On: 205, Maker3/Leather: 153
Manual checklist saved for UI/localization/responsive checks: tests/manual_checklist.md
All critical acceptance criteria met: D-01..D-08, M-01..M-05, P-06..P-09, S-02/S-04/S-13, L-01/L-02, X-01..X-03

history.event: Step 2 v6 — Data corrections + Plastic category + retrain (12 categories, N_IN=20)
history.details: 1) Applied tamayuzucraft corrections: 74 Joy blade normalizations (ファインポイント→ファインポイントブレード), 20 real data changes across Maker3 (13) and Explore3 (7) — key: Linen/Cotton Bonded and Faux suede pressure+blade corrected from rotary to fine-point. 2) Added 'Plastic' category: 26 rows reclassified from Others/Paper (Acetate, Foil Acetate, Mylar, Transparency, Stencil Film, Cutting Mat Protector, Plastic Packaging, Plastic Canvas, Window Cling). 3) enrich_features.py + train_model.py updated with Plastic defaults (thickness=0.10, hardness=4, GSM=150, density=1350, shore=70). 4) All 5 ONNX models retrained (N_IN=20). 5) materials.json rebuilt (1039 rows, 12 categories). 6) predict.js, app.js, i18n.js updated with Plastic support.

history.event: Step 2 v5 — External data import + 90/10 split (1039 rows, 5 ONNX files)
history.details: Imported 319 new entries from tamayuzucraft community database (Joy+58, Explore3+103, Maker3+158). Dataset grew from 720→1039 training rows. Split changed to 90/10. Key improvements: Explore3 blade acc 100% (was ~68%), Maker3 MAPE 22.8% (was 31.3%), Explore3 MAPE 28.4%, Joy MC 85.7%. Global pressure: log_mean=5.5021, log_std=0.9385. scripts/import_external_data.py created.

history.event: Step 2 v4 — Sequential transfer learning (19 features, 5 ONNX files)
history.details: Pre-train on other machines (Maker3→Explore3→JoyXtra→Joy2→Joy order), fine-tune on target. Global pressure normalization. Key results: Maker 3 MAPE 31.3% (was 34.9%), MC acc 65.1% (was 50.8%); Joy Xtra blade acc 100% (was 81.8%). Fine-tune best epochs: Maker3=720, Explore3=420 — model actually training vs epoch 15-40 in v2/v3.

history.event: Step 2 v3 — Per-machine models (19 features, 5 ONNX files)
history.details: Retrained with one model per machine. Machine one-hot removed; per-machine pressure normalization. Joy: MAPE 22.7%, Maker 3: 34.9%. Joy/Joy 2 improved dramatically; Explore 3/Joy Xtra still limited by small data. 5 ONNX files: cricut_joy, cricut_joy2, cricut_joy_xtra, explore3, maker3. preprocessor.json v3 with per-machine pressure params.

history.event: Step 2 v2 — Feature enrichment + retrain (24 features)
history.details: CSV enriched with 5 new columns: GSM, Surface Texture, Has Adhesive, Density (kg/m3), Shore Hardness A. Script: scripts/enrich_features.py. Single model MAPE 39.2% — no improvement over v1 due to best epoch still being 15. Confirmed root cause: mixed machine scales + small dataset.

history.event: Material physics research completed — Step 2 extended
history.details: User rejected initial ML val results (MAPE 38.5%, blade acc 81.2%). Conducted academic research on die-cutting mechanics, paper/vinyl/leather/fabric/foam/wood physical properties. Identified 5 new CSV columns to add: GSM, Surface Texture, Has Adhesive, Density, Shore Hardness. Research saved to .claude/research/research_material_physics_2026-06-06.md.

history.event: Step 2 completed — ML Model Training & ONNX Export
history.details: MLP trained on 723 rows (5 machines). Blade accuracy 84.8%, pressure MAE 26-55 for non-rotary materials. ONNX exported (200 KB). preprocessor.json saved with full encoding spec.

history.event: Step 1 fully completed — Deep Research (all 5 machines)
history.details: 6 research files written. Joy 2 (84 rows) and Joy Xtra (112 rows) CSVs created from user-provided Design Space data. Explore 5 deferred to Explore 3 proxy. Combined CSV updated to 729 rows (5 machines). Step 2 ready to begin.

history.event: Step 1 initial completion — Deep Research (3 machines)
history.details: 3 research files written: research_cricut_style_2026-06-06.md, research_cricut_machines_2026-06-06.md, research_material_properties_2026-06-06.md. CSS extracted from live cricut.com. CSV analyzed for machine/material data.
Spec reviewed, CLAUDE.md created, .claude/commands/ skills created (researcher, programmer, designer), project_history.json initialized. Python venv setup in progress.

decisions.decision: MLP neural network (PyTorch) selected as the ML model
decisions.rationale: User confirmed. Exports cleanly to ONNX, runs in-browser via onnxruntime-web.
No server needed; deploy to GitHub Pages or Netlify.

decisions.decision: App has two main features: searchable known material list + ML prediction for unknowns
decisions.rationale: User confirmed both features are needed.
